entities.summary: Gouraud, a notable figure in the history of Lebanon, associated with French Mandate and Independence (1920–1926). Preceded by General Gouraud proclaims the State of Greater Lebanon and Lebanese Republic proclaimed with a constitution based on the French model. Their legacy influenced Last French troops leave Lebanon and National Pact — unwritten agreement on confessional power-sharing.
